Plotly Cartesian 3.7.0 is vendored for both the local server and standalone HTML.
It supplies the viewer's heatmap, scatter, and bar traces without the full
bundle's WebGL/map worker initialization. No runtime CDN access is required.

Source: https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-cartesian-3.7.0.min.js
Bundle documentation: https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js/blob/v3.7.0/dist/README.md
License: MIT; see LICENSE.plotly.txt and the bundle's embedded notices.
SHA-256: `7c593b9eda0e74a1d07335cf89cbf7a55ffc114909980c3729af835453bdb02a`

Keep this file, the filename in `ai4water_eggs/viewer.py`, and the checksum together when
updating. Rebuild standalone HTML files after a bundle update.
